name: Huélaga (Spain)
description: Green field with two thin white stripes each charged with two black rectangles, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Huélaga (crossed keys and a cross of Alcántara above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Huélaga; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: two black rectangles on each white stripe
